result:
The second integration run was stopped at about 02:48 UTC when it hit the background time limit. It printed no summary and no exit code. I didn't restart it because the 2-hour budget had already passed.

When it stopped, it had reported 186 of the 326 test files: 184 passed and 2 had failures. Those are the same two files as before, `budget.test.ts` and `registers-report.test.ts`, and both pass when run alone (13/13 and 5/5).

I've recorded the stop in the handback (§3a and §8) and added a note at the end of `test-integration-run2.log` saying the log is partial. The integration check is still **not completed** and needs a full re-run on the merged tree when the host is quieter. Nothing else in my earlier report changes.
